name: Litemint.io
author: Addicting Games
description: Litemint.io is a free iogame. This is a game about strategy, a game about cards, a game about healing, and a game about deckbuilding. Many of us enjoy the casual fun inherent in sitting down with our friends and playing card games. Litemint flips the script by replacing your friends with robots who you have to play cards against. Play attack cards which will deplete them of their energy, and then play cards to heal yourself. It is a riveting game of strategy, attacking, defending, and healing. In between games you will have a currency you can use to buy more cards and build up your own custom deck that will work exactly the way you want it to. This is a laser themed, future-paced version of your favorite collectible card games. If you like building a deck an then playing that deck against your opponents, you'll love this game. It is a desktop version of a classic card game. Crazy? Maybe. Fun? Sometimes. But ultimately it is a rewarding challenge that you can play for free again and again until you've built the ultimate deck to destroy your robo-opponents. Jump into the arena and prove your worth, now!
